name: Falling for Mr. Lu
overview: To save her family’s failing business, Lin Chuxia is forced into a marriage with the rumored disfigured Lu Li. Determined to reclaim control of her family’s company, she forms an uneasy alliance with him, only to face constant sabotage from her own relatives. As Lu Li quietly protects and supports her, Lin Chuxia begins to suspect there is more to her mysterious husband than he reveals.
